meaning:
spreading place
Also means: mish.to.ach (מִשְׁטוֹחַ "spreading-place" H4894B)

renderings.kjv: It shall be a place for the spreading
thou shalt be a place to spread
they shall be a place to spread forth

elsewhere.note: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
